# Elixir ground truth

Generated by `capture.sh` from the Elixir app before the Go port. The Go
compatibility tests (`internal/db/compat_test.go` and friends) read these files.
Regenerate only if the Elixir code changes; do not hand-edit.

- `schema.db` — empty DB after all 77 Ecto migrations.
- `populated.db` — rows written by the real Elixir code (fixtures + kickoff functions), including jobs in every Oban state.
- `golden/schema.sql` — `.schema` of `schema.db`.
- `golden/populated_values.txt` — `table|rowid|column|typeof|quote(value)` for every stored value.
- `golden/user_script_*.json` — Jason encodings passed to user lifecycle scripts.
- `golden/rss_*.xml`, `golden/opml.xml` — podcast feed output for `populated.db` with `url_base = http://pinchflat.test:8945`.

`internal/db/migrations/*.sql` are the exact statements Ecto ran for each migration,
captured with `mix ecto.migrate --log-migrations-sql` (statements separated by `-- +statement`).

Elixir baseline at capture time: `mix test` → 972 tests, 0 failures.

The Elixir app was deleted at cutover. To re-run `capture.sh`, check out
commit `5ae7e94` (the last one containing it).
